title: Learn 5 New Words in 30 Seconds (With Pictures) #shorts
description:
Learn five words in thirty seconds, with pictures.
• Sprint: run for the bus as fast as you can
• Whisper: speak very quietly in a library
• Giggle: children laughing at a silly joke
• Yawn: open your mouth wide when you're tired
• Stare: look at something for a long time

Which picture will you remember tomorrow? Tell me in the comments.

Find more words on anotherwordfor.net
